Feature: Lab and Patient Interaction

  As a patient, I want to have my lab requests routed to the laboratory after matching my Patient Pincode
  As a lab personnel, I want to make appointments and perform home collection of specimen
  As a patient, I want to upload reports directly to the system
  As a doctor, I want to diagnose based on patient consultations
  As a patient, I want to consult with a single specialist doctor
  As a doctor, I want to use a machine learning algorithm to predict diseases

Scenario Outline: Routing Lab Requests
  Given a patient with a valid pincode
    When I submit a lab request
    Then my request should be routed to the laboratory

Scenario Outline: Appointment and Home Collection
  Given a lab personnel with access to the system
    When I schedule an appointment
    Then the appointment should be confirmed

Scenario Outline: Report Upload
  Given a patient with access to the system
    When I upload a report
    Then the report should be accepted

Scenario Outline: Consultation with a Specialist
  Given a patient with access to the system
    When I request a consultation
    Then I should be assigned to a specialist doctor

Scenario Outline: Diagnosis Modification
  Given a doctor with access to the system
    When I receive a diagnosis
    Then I should be able to modify it

Scenario Outline: Machine Learning Assistance
  Given a doctor with access to the system
    When I input symptoms
    Then the machine learning algorithm should assist in predicting diseases

Scenario Outline: Doctor's Responsibility
  Given a doctor with access to the system
    When I perform a diagnosis
    Then I should be responsible for the outcome


Examples:
  | Patient Pincode | Lab Request | Expected Routing |
  | 123456         | Blood Test  | Laboratory         |
  | 654321         | Urine Test  | Laboratory         |

  | Lab Personnel | Appointment | Confirmation       |
  | Lab Personnel | Home Collection | Confirmation       |
  | Patient | Report | Accepted           |
  | Patient | Report | Up to 5 reports |
  | Doctor | Symptoms | Predicted Disease |
  | Doctor | Diagnosis | Modified Diagnosis |
